# SPA.1 — Vite toolchain + ADR-106 + bundle budgets

Manifest row 98 — **first round-4 (frontend-SPA) ticket** · stacks on
`stevevitali/res-3-leg1a-zero-coverage` @ `b912f6b` · merge policy **OPERATOR** — do not merge
from the build environment · **$0** spend, no deploys, no production writes.

Implements `docs/tickets/98_SPA.1__vite-toolchain-adr106.md` per
`docs/frontend-spa-spec.md` §3.5/§9 and `docs/design/21_spa-toolchain.md`.

**Deployable dark:** everything here is additive and inert — `vite build` emits to
`apps/web/public/spa/` and **nothing serves it** until SPA.3's shell document and SPA.4's
skeleton exist. The esbuild island pipeline (`build-client.mjs`) is byte-for-byte unchanged;
public/marketing/login stay Hono SSR; SSR remains the fallback everywhere.

## What lands

- **ADR-106** (`docs/adr/ADR-106-spa-shell-tanstack-vite.md`) — commits the design/20 draft nearly
  verbatim: auth'd surfaces migrate to TanStack Router + Query built by Vite; **amends ADR-007**
  (no-Vite ruling scoped to the REQ-BETA-21 throwaway) **and ADR-012** (island idiom superseded
  per surface as flags flip). Dated amendment pointers appended to both ADRs; `docs/adr/README.md`
  regenerated by the index tool (never hand-edited).
- **`apps/web/vite.config.ts`** — `publicDir: false`, `appType: "custom"`, `outDir: "public/spa"`,
  `manifest: true`, `sourcemap: "hidden"`, `modulePreload.polyfill: false`; the `tanstackRouter`
  plugin precedes `react()` (load-bearing order).
- **Pins** (≥7-day staleness re-verified 2026-10-08): vite `~8.3.1`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`
  `~6.1.1`, `@tanstack/router-plugin` `1.168.41`, `@tanstack/react-router` `1.170.40`,
  `@tanstack/react-query` `^5.104.0`, `react`/`react-dom` `^19.3.0` + `^19.3.0` types. Root engine
  floor `>=20` → **`>=20.19`** (Vite 8 requirement).
- **Scaffold** `src/spa/` (`main.tsx`, `__root.tsx`, `index.tsx`, committed `routeTree.gen.ts`) —
  mounts only on `[data-spa-root]`; absent ⇒ no-op.
- **Wiring** — `build:spa` / `dev:spa` (`vite build --watch`, smoke-verified) scripts;
  `typecheck` += `tsconfig.spa.json`; `build` += `vite build`; turbo `build.outputs` += `public/**`;
  CI `public-safe` builds `--filter=@rhema/web...` **before** gitleaks/marker-scan and runs
  `check:spa-budget` after them; Dockerfile strips `public/spa/**/*.map` from the runtime image
  (CI `images` job exercises it).
- **Budget gate** — `scripts/check-spa-budget.mjs` + `apps/web/spa-budget.json`: hard gzip
  ceilings (entry ≤250 kB, lazy editor ≤400, CodeMirror ≤130, other async ≤150/file, total JS
  ≤800, CSS ≤60). Fail-closed on missing manifest; Unicode-safe paths.
- **`apps/web/README.md`** — the watched dev loop.

## React 19 → test updates (semantics preserved)

React 18 → 19 (R26: newest stable ≥7d) changes SSR attribute serialization — `required` emits as
`required=""`, `formAction` keeps DOM-property case. Three string-pin assertions updated to pin
semantics (required-presence on the code input's tag; case-insensitive `formaction`); the
code-before-email ordering, no-`<details>`, and payment-link endpoint checks are unchanged.
**Zero component changes** — all other tests pass as-is.

## License exceptions added (checked-in mechanism, precedented)

`caniuse-lite` CC-BY-4.0 (build-time browserslist/babel data, never shipped) · `lightningcss` +
7 platform binaries MPL-2.0 (optional Vite CSS peer resolved when vite@8 entered the graph;
axe-core/resvg precedents — build-time only, unmodified).
